title: Balanced vs Unbalanced Forces
guideExplore: Adjust left/right forces and mass — press Play and watch the block on the track.
guideBalanced: Balanced: equal forces cancel — net force is zero.
guidePushRight: Push right: stronger right force accelerates the block rightward.
guidePushLeft: Push left: stronger left force accelerates the block leftward.
conditionsHint: Equal opposite forces give zero net force — the block stays still.
learnMore: Forces are pushes or pulls. When equal and opposite forces act on an object, they balance and net force is zero.
